data.mdl_comment:
GS1 demo =========
This module contains a demo of [GS1 standards](https://www.gs1.org) standards within Simplicité.

data.obo_comment: `GTIN`: Internationally unique product identifier managed by the GS1 Organization

`UDI`: A medical device universal identifier.
`UDI` = `UDI-DI` (static _device identifier_ = the GTIN) + `UDI-PI` (_production identifiers_)

data.tsl_simplehelp: The UDI as printed under the barcode, AIs in parentheses, e.g. (01)00614141999996(17)271231(10)A1B2C3.
